messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

In one study, plasma clearance in people aged 65 and over was about 40% lower than in adults aged 25 to 32, so it took 2 to 3 weeks to reach steady levels rather than about 1 week. Doctors usually start older adults at the low end of the dose range. Older adults are also at greater risk of low sodium levels in the blood, particularly if they take diuretics (water pills) or are dehydrated.

B. 'has longer elimination duration in': The subject drug takes a longer time to be fully eliminated from the body in the group specified by the object entity.
